title: Lab 02 Report: Spotify Playlist Requirements Prioritization

sections.title: 1. Spotify Requirements
sections.placeholder: What two Spotify API rules did you find? Explain each rule briefly and give its document label (D1, D2, D3, or D4).

sections.title: 2. Playlist Testing
sections.placeholder: Which playlist actions did you test? What happened when you tried FR-06 before and after fixing the Python code?

sections.title: 3. Python Changes
sections.placeholder: What did you change in playlist_policy_ok() and requirement_utility()? Show how you calculated FR-01's utility of 3.70.

sections.title: 4. Release Planning
sections.placeholder: Which features were selected with an 8-day budget and a 6-day budget? Give the selected IDs, total engineer-days, and total utility for each case.

sections.title: 5. AI and Verification
sections.placeholder: Which AI tool did you use and what did it recommend? Compare its recommended features with Python. Did it follow the rules? How many of the five tests passed?

sections.title: 6. Final Recommendation
sections.placeholder: Which features would you develop first, and why? Base your answer on the stakeholder scores, budget, and Spotify requirements.
